Video of the console powering on and showing the home screen/library with the installed games list.

Video showing gameplay for 20–30 minutes (or a temperature/fan check) to confirm no overheating/shutdown.
Photo of the UK receipt and a full list of included items (power cable, HDMI cable, controller(s), etc.).
response.reason: From the photos, it’s a PS4 console with one controller, but the key value drivers (exact PS4 model, installed games, port functionality, overheating/health, and receipt/accessories) are not provable remotely. Request the specific proof items before pricing.
